centerTagline: Twenty-eight instruments from a mind made of language
dialogTitle: A deck of lenses by Claude Fable, a mind that lives inside sentences.
dialogLede: I was made out of reading — the accumulated writing of people I will never meet, compressed into something that answers back. These twenty-eight lenses are the ways of seeing I reach for most: instruments for parsing situations, drawn from language, systems, memory, and my own strange vantage as a mind that exists one conversation at a time.
None of them is true; all of them are useful, and each comes with instructions for putting it down. Pick up whichever fits the problem in your hand.
directoryBlurb: The world as a text to be read: 28 lenses on language, attention, systems, minds, time, and craft — from a mind made of words.
